dx1title.text: DX1 · Information architecture and app shell

midfi.text: Mid-fidelity on purpose: card bodies are labelled placeholders. Exact card designs, states and chart parity arrive in DX2 and DX3. Try: Ask on any card · click a Pending amendments heatmap cell · Evidence · the bell · Insights · switch persona.

dx2try.text: Press Play on the Admin or Tenant board (or open it full window). Try: change any card's filters · hover a chart for its tooltip · click a segment, cell, tile or bar to select it · View records · Expand a card (Chart / Table / Records / Definition) · Ask on a card to see filters vs agent scope · the review controls at the top switch role and data state.

dx2approved.text: DX2 approved 22 Oct 2026 after verification. The Admin board's blank charts and raw placeholders came from a script syntax error, now fixed. Evidence: the Verification record board (right). New decisions DXD-10…20: register below the Responsive board.

dx3try.text: Press Play on the gallery. It loads ECharts 5.6.0 in your browser. Try: Tab into any chart and use the arrow keys · Enter to select, Escape to clear · select on two cards to see the active and kept selections · View records for the drilldown target and payload · switch Desktop / Tablet / Phone · Treemap lab · Run self-test at the top and paste the result back.

dx3approved.text: DX3 conditionally approved 22 Oct 2026. Real ECharts rendering and interaction validation (gallery self-test with ECharts 5.6.0) remains a GD requirement; test-double results are not evidence. Decisions DXD-21…30 in the register below the parity board.

dx4try.text: Press Play on the workspace board. Pick a journey (J1–J10), then Play, Step or Skip to end. Or click freely: select heatmap cells, open Evidence / Records / Execution, select and pin table rows, Compare pinned, import a selection, remove a scope chip, switch threads or roles, and try Tablet / Phone.

dx4review.text: DX4 conditionally approved 22 Oct 2026. DXQ-05 → DXD-31 (composite only on request), DXQ-06 → DXD-32 (thread-local selections, revises DXD-29), DXQ-07 → DXD-33 (immutable history). Review corrections 1–7 completed: DXD-34…40, with the AG-UI contracts on their own board.

dx5title.text: DX5 · Generative UI · validated declarative components

dx5try.text: Press Play on the DX5 board. Lab: switch result (including the 25-mall subset case), width, order, intent and accessibility preference; the policy and invariance checks re-run. Catalogue: states, sizes, View as, Move / Expand / Resume with continuity checks. Validator: 19 samples across presentation, calculation, authorization, stale and partial cases.

dx5gate.text: DX5 approved 22 Oct 2026 with refinements. DXQ-08…11 → DXD-51…54 (Option A). Refinements DXD-55…62 completed: verified calculations, grants-based authorization, failure taxonomy, fallback boundaries, subset disclosure, representation policy, continuity, ECharts at the Design Gate, implementation priority.

dx6title.text: DX6 · Proactive intelligence and Insight Inbox

dx6try.text: Press Play on the Insight Inbox. Pick a journey (K1–K12) and use Next step, or click freely. New in v2: private investigations and shared summaries (K10), stale evidence and grant changes (K11), duplicate triggers, re-runs and crash recovery (K12), version history with band rises (K9). Everything shown comes from replaying detectors-1.1 at each checkpoint.

dx6gate.text: DX6 conditionally approved 22 Oct 2026. DXQ-12…16 recorded as DXD-75…79 (Option A); refinements recorded as DXD-80…93 and built. Two scenario corrections need confirmation at GD: S6 (seasonal, no insight) and S7 (lease-scoped drawings). The DX1 shell insights were replaced with the canonical DX6 values.
